results.title: G2 vs Capterra vs Trustpilot vs TechnologyMatch: Which Vendor Discovery Platform Is Best for IT Leaders?
results.content:
G2 focuses on verified user reviews with 150K+ products and detailed comparison grids, while Capterra emphasizes breadth with 2M+ products and free vendor listings. Both use incentivized review programs and lead generation business models that immediately share your contact information with vendors. Neither offers IT-specific technical depth, vendor vetting, or requirements-based evaluation frameworks that complex IT vendor selection requires. [...] Trustpilot and G2 answer different questions. G2 collects software-specific peer reviews with feature-level detail and comparison grids, so it helps you shortlist products in a category. Trustpilot collects open customer feedback about a company's reputation and service quality, with no software comparison tools or IT category structure. Use G2 to compare products and Trustpilot to sanity-check a vendor's reputation, and treat neither as sufficient for a high-stakes IT decision on its own. Runner-up: G2. 150K+ products with reviews and ratings.

results.title: G2 to Acquire Capterra, Software Advice, and GetApp from Gartner
results.content:
For Buyers: We are removing noise and providing you with more helpful information during your purchasing process. With access to 6 million verified reviews in one place, you can trust G2 to be your ultimate guide to B2B software. And, through G2.ai, we’ll be able to deliver AI-driven recommendations at a scale that was previously impossible. [...] Today, that approach enters its most significant chapter yet.

I’m thrilled to share that G2 has formally agreed to acquire the software discovery and recommendation platforms Capterra, Software Advice, and GetApp from Gartner.

This is a transformational moment for G2, and, more importantly, the global B2B software industry. By bringing together four of the leading software discovery platforms, we are creating the definitive system of record for B2B software in the age of AI.
